text:
Zoe Carter: Hey team, first-week network snag. Installed Okta Gateway on my laptop and VPN shows connected, but `ssh ubuntu@10.6.8.9` to the bastion immediately returns "Network is unreachable" on my Fedora laptop. Browser shows Okta connected. Any tips?
Marek Novak: welcome Zoe! quick checks: what's `ip route` and `ip -6 route`? Also check `ping6` to the VPN gateway in case IPv6 is shadowing the route.
Zoe Carter: `ip route` shows `10.0.0.0/8 via 169.254.5.1 dev tun0` and default via home router. `ip -6 route` shows a global IPv6 default via my ISP. traceroute to 10.6.8.9 fails with "Network unreachable" immediately.
Marek Novak: ah this looks like an IPv6/dual-stack quirk where the system tries IPv6 first for certain sockets then fails to fall back. Two quick fixes: 1) temporarily disable IPv6 (`sudo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=1`) to see if it helps, or 2) add an explicit host route for the bastion IPv4: `sudo ip route add 10.6.8.9/32 via 169.254.5.1 dev tun0`. Which do you prefer?
Zoe Carter: tried adding the host route and `ssh ubuntu@10.6.8.9` connected! Disabling IPv6 also works but I didn't want to change global stack. The single-host route is perfect for now.
infra-bot: Zoe Carter's IAM tag `corp-ssh-access` is pending. Please request infra approval in #eng-infra to enable console SSM sessions.
Zoe Carter: filed infra request with employee id. Also, FYI for docs: add a note about IPv6 causing immediate failures for some first-weekers using consumer ISPs.
okta-bot: Okta Gateway session refreshed. Zoe Carter, re-auth in browser to ensure full route/DNS push.
Marek Novak: good catch — we'll add a short troubleshooting blurb to the new-hire VPN doc: "If 'Network unreachable' occurs despite VPN connected, try an explicit IPv4 host route via the VPN gateway or temporarily disable IPv6 to verify dual-stack interference."
Zoe Carter: thanks all, saved to my onboarding checklist and dropping the host-route command here: `sudo ip route add 10.6.8.9/32 via 169.254.5.1 dev tun0` :tada:
